        s = path.lstat()
        rel = str(path.relative_to(root))
        data = os.readlink(path) if path.is_symlink() else hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
        result[rel] = (stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), data)
    return result
before = snapshot()
status_before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], cwd=root)
revisions = {name: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', name], cwd=root, text=True).strip() for name in ['HEAD"'^'"', 'HEAD']}
scratch = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.policy-verification-', dir=root))
try:
    for name, revision in revisions.items():
        dest = scratch / ('parent' if name == 'HEAD"'^'"' else 'head')
        shutil.copytree(root, dest, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.git', scratch.name), copy_function=shutil.copy2)

        print('TEST_SHA256 ' + hashlib.sha256((dest / 'tests/policy.test.mjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print('COMMAND node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/policy.test.mjs', flush=True)
        run = subprocess.run(['node', '--test', '--test-reporter=tap', 'tests/policy.test.mjs'], cwd=dest, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(run.stdout, end='', flush=True)
        print(f'NATIVE_EXIT {run.returncode}', flush=True)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(scratch)
after = snapshot()
status_after = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], cwd=root)
print('ORIGINAL_BYTES_MODES_AND_PATHS_UNCHANGED', before == after)
print('GIT_STATUS_UNCHANGED', status_before == status_after)
print('GIT_STATUS', repr(status_after.decode()))
print('OWNED_SCRATCH_REMOVED', not scratch.exists())
